crossRefs.note: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and…
they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in…

translations.web: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.
translations.bsb: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
translations.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
translations.asv: And the most part of the multitude spread their garments in the way; and others cut branches from the trees, and spread them in the way.
